reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code are what get me, plus the empty-box refund means I risk very little. At $24.99 for the first box I would try one, and the sachets are easy to throw in my bag when I travel for work.
objection: Still $0.83 a day when I can usually find magnesium for less per day, and two capsules every day is a lot to swallow. I will not reorder at $29.99 unless there is a coupon or a flash sale.
would_change_my_mind: A lower price per day on a repeat box, like a coupon or a flash sale on the second box, would get me to reorder.
